name: Minamoto no Hitoshi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 39); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 10th century.

poems.title: ’Tis easier to hide the reeds
poems.author: Minamoto no Hitoshi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 39
poems.text:
’Tis easier to hide the reeds
Upon the moor that grow,
Than try to hide the ardent love
That sets my cheeks aglow
For somebody I know.

poems.title: 39. 浅茅生の 小野の篠原 しのぶれど (Asajiu no ono no shinohara shinoburedo)
poems.author: Minamoto no Hitoshi
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後撰集
poems.text:
浅茅生の 小野の篠原 しのぶれど
あまりてなどか 人の戀しき
